Small balanced tomato-only PlantVillage image subset, described by the manifest:
../../processed/plantvillage_tomato_subset.csv

Source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mohanty/PlantVillage
Source split files are used as published to keep training and test records separate.
The CSV links to source images and records source class, binary label, split, and source URL.

License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 (CC BY-SA 3.0).
Attribution: Mohanty, Hughes, and Salathe (2016), "Using deep learning for image-based plant
disease detection," Frontiers in Plant Science, DOI 10.3389/fpls.2016.01419.

The dataset contains leaf images captured under controlled conditions. Its labels are image-level
healthy/disease labels; they are not field-level agronomic diagnoses or risk labels.
